meta.title: Empathy & Emotional Attunement Assessment
meta.description: A self-reflection test that explores how attuned you are to others' emotions and perspectives across 10 dimensions of empathy.

levels.label: Deeply Empathetic
levels.desc: You consistently tune into others' feelings and act on that understanding, even when it costs you time or comfort. People feel truly seen and heard around you.

levels.label: Highly Attuned
levels.desc: You pick up on others' emotions readily and usually respond with care. A few situations — like conflict or unfamiliar contexts — are still worth extra attention.

levels.label: Considerate
levels.desc: You generally notice when someone needs support and try to help, though busyness or distraction sometimes get in the way.

levels.label: Developing
levels.desc: Your empathic responses are situational — strong with people close to you, less consistent with strangers or those who differ from you.

levels.label: Guarded
levels.desc: You often stay focused on your own perspective, and others' emotional cues don't always register or prompt a response. Small, deliberate habits could shift this.

levels.label: Needs Reflection
levels.desc: Your answers suggest that tuning into others' feelings rarely factors into your responses right now. This is a good starting point for honest self-reflection.
